result.title: Export my requests as CSV: specification
result.content:
# Export my requests as CSV

Status: In progress (SUP-142)
Owner: Ada Example

## Goal
A customer can download all of their own support requests as one CSV file.

## Scope
- A button named Export CSV on the Requests list screen.
- One row per request, with these columns: id, title, status, created, updated.
- Only the requests of the signed-in customer are exported.

## Safety
- Cells starting with =, +, - or @ get a leading apostrophe (SUP-143).
- The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark so spreadsheets read accents correctly.

## Out of scope
- Sharing a request by link (SUP-120).
